messages:
marta: Hey team — customer opened a ticket with intermittent 502s on /v1/generate. They gave an X-Request-Id header value of `rq_20260315_xyz789` and said it happened ~2026-03-15T15:12:00Z. Can someone pull the server-side traces/logs?

vikram: Got it. Two quick asks: 1) can you confirm the full request_id string they sent (sometimes they trim), 2) which customer/org id? we need tenant scope for log queries.

marta: They gave `rq_20260315_xyz789` exactly and org id `org_842`. I pasted the support ticket into the thread.

eli: If the request_id is correct we should find an indexed entry. Quick Kibana query I run:
```
service:api AND (request_id.keyword: "rq_20260315_xyz789" OR http.request.headers.x_request_id: "rq_20260315_xyz789")
```
That looks across the ingest index. If you want Stackdriver/Cloud Logging syntax instead: `resource.labels.project_id=\"redwood-prod\" AND jsonPayload.request_id=\"rq_20260315_xyz789\"`

ops-bot: FYI retention: ingest indices keep request metadata (request_id, status, latency) for 90 days. Full request payloads are purged after 30 days. Traces stored in Jaeger for 180 days. If the event is older than retention we can only rely on traces/alerts.

vikram: Thanks. If the record is missing because of retention, the fallback is to ask customer for a reproducible curl and to enable debug headers so we can correlate a new request. Example minimal repro we ask them to run:
```
curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>" \
  -H "X-Request-Id: rq_repro_$(date +%s)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-large","input":"<short prompt>"}'
```
Request them to paste the `X-Request-Id` back and the exact timestamp.

marta: If I run the Kibana query now I get no hits — probably older than 90 days? This incident was ~5 weeks ago though, so should still be there. Any other indices I should search?

eli: Try `ingest-*` and `request-metrics-*` indexes and widen time window +/- 1h. Also check the gateway logs in `edge-*` in case it failed there before reaching API. Example query with OR: `index: (ingest-* OR edge-*) AND request_id.keyword: \"rq_20260315_xyz789\"`. If still nothing, run the trace lookup using trace_id if available: `trace_id: "..."`

vikram: I can run a targeted search from infra. @support-bot can you collect the debug-bundle for org_842 and that request id window? include logs + traces + routing table snapshot.

support-bot: Collecting debug bundle for org=org_842, start=2026-03-15T14:45:00Z, end=2026-03-15T15:30:00Z, correlation_id=rq_20260315_xyz789. Bundle prep may take ~90s.

jamie: Also check if the customer hit a rate-limit or billing block around that time (historical billing spikes sometimes cause gateway 502s). Query billing-events: `org_id:org_842 AND timestamp:[2026-03-15T14:50 TO 2026-03-15T15:20] AND event_type:chargeback`

ops-bot: Debug bundle ready: /internal/debugs/1776543210-org_842-rq_20260315_xyz789.tar.gz :magnifying_glass_tilted_left:

eli: Downloading and inspecting. Quick scan shows a proxy 502 from edge at 15:12:03Z, upstream timed out to model-serving-gpu-7. I'm pulling the per-worker logs next.

marta: Thanks — appreciate the quick triage. If we confirm an upstream OOM or retry loop we should mark as P1 for Dedicated customers. I'll update the ticket with the bundle link and next steps. :thumbsup:
